entity_note: 扩展批次（第五批之一）。研究主体为 Boston Dynamics 整公司；旗舰工业产品为全电 Atlas 人形机器人与 Spot 四足机器人。

evidence.claim: CES 2026 报道：Boston Dynamics 展示全电人形机器人 Atlas 的产品版本；宣布与 Google DeepMind 合作，由后者在 Atlas 与 Spot 等机器人上部署 Gemini Robotics 模型并测试；Atlas 已在公司波士顿总部开始生产，2026 年的部署额度已全部被预订，机队将分别交付至现代汽车的 Robotics Metaplant Application Centre（RMAC）与 Google
evidence.quote: Boston Dynamics showcased the product version of its fully electric humanoid robot, Atlas, at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2026 in Las Vegas. … Boston Dynamics announced a collaboration with Google DeepMind, which will deploy the Gemini Robotics model on various Boston Dynamics robots, including the new Atlas and its robot dog, Spot. … With productions of the robot beginning at the company's Boston headquarters, all deployments have already been committed for 2026, with fleets scheduled to ship to Hyundai's Robotics Metaplant Application Centre (RMAC) and Google
evidence.source_title: CES 2026: Boston Dynamics To Deploy Google AI-Powered Atlas Robot At Hyundai Factories
evidence.note: 交付对象为现代 RMAC 与 Google，属具名交付安排；「2026 年部署额度已全部被预订」为报道表述，未给台数。

evidence.claim: 官网自述：Atlas 是面向工业场景的全电人形机器人，用于物料搬运等企业应用，支持条码扫描与工作流集成、自主导航至充电站并自行更换电池；能力可在 Atlas 机队间复制部署；Orbit 平台用于把 Atlas 接入 MES、WMS 等系统并管理机队绩效
evidence.quote: Atlas isn't just built for our world. It's built to transform it, revolutionizing industrial workspaces with unmatched strength and intelligent autonomy. … Atlas requires minimal supervision for a range of material handling applications and supports barcode scanning and other workflow integrations. … Built with the latest advancements in AI, when one Atlas learns a new skill, that task can easily be deployed across your entire Atlas fleet. … Orbit is your single source of truth: your tool to connect Atlas to MES, WMS, and other systems of record
evidence.quote_locator: 产品页 Atlas 介绍段与 Orbit 段
evidence.note: 官网为当前状态自述，未提供发布日期，故不作为日期依据。

evidence.claim: DHL Group 于 2025-05-13 宣布：Stretch 已用于集装箱卸货，DHL Supply Chain 2023 年在北美商业引入并扩展至英国与欧洲；同时签署再部署超过 1000 台的谅解备忘录，后者为计划／意向，不是已交付。
evidence.quote: 05/13/2025, 10:00 AM CEST … Building on the proven success of Boston Dynamics' Stretch robot - designed for case handling and initially deployed by DHL to automate container unloading - the agreement paves the way for the global deployment of more than 1,000 additional units. … DHL Supply Chain, the Group's contract logistics division, has led the way, introducing Stretch commercially in North America in 2023 and more recently expanding deployments to the United Kingdom and across Europe.
evidence.quote_locator: 日期行与正文第 1、3 段
evidence.source_title: DHL Group signs MOU with Boston Dynamics for additional 1,000-robot deployment
